# Social security indexation

Find the latest social security (income support and supplementary payments) rates and means testing parameters.

## On this page

- [About social security indexation](https://www.dss.gov.au/income-support-payments/social-security-indexation#about-social-security-indexation)
- [Latest rates](https://www.dss.gov.au/income-support-payments/social-security-indexation#latest-rates)
- [Previous rates](https://www.dss.gov.au/income-support-payments/social-security-indexation#previous-rates)

## About social security indexation

Based on the following legislation, social security payment rates and thresholds are indexed regularly to maintain their value over time:

- [Social Security Act 1991(Opens in a new tab/window)](https://www.legislation.gov.au/C2004A04121/latest/text)
- [A New Tax System (Family Assistance) Act 1999(Opens in a new tab/window)](https://www.legislation.gov.au/C2004A00491/latest/text).
